modules.reason: module is off; attach it: acos_launch {"services": [{"id": "feedback.vibrator", "profile": "scripted"}]}

scripted profile: scripted SIM/network/line-1 answers, 0 recorded outgoing SMS, 0 injected incoming SMS, 101 call-state listener(s); no radio, no real SMS transport; `getSimOperator*`/`getSimCountryIso` read guest system properties a module cannot set and stay ""; no `isub`, so binder calls arrive with subId=-1 and are answered by slot 0; at-launch only (the framework telephony initializer is installed before the app boots, as the phone process does); sent/delivery PendingIntents are recorded but never fired (no PendingIntent scheduler)

off: no print service; the client only resolves the name when FEATURE_PRINTING is reported, and ACOS reports it absent

off: nothing records app usage; an empty ParceledListSlice<UsageStats> would be indistinguishable from 'not used'
off: no managed device or profile; every device-policy answer would be invented policy state
off: IRoleManager lives in the Permission APEX; its transaction table is not in the framework dex this build reads, so a stub would guess codes
